description: Publish one of the user's COMPLETED videos. YOUTUBE: uploads to the connected channel with your title/description and privacy (public, unlisted, private); the "altered or synthetic content" disclosure is always set; madeForKids is the user's COPPA answer (ask them for a kids audience); nothing is appended to the description unless addAttribution is true (default false — only when the user asked for "Made with StoryShort"). TIKTOK: sends the video to the creator's TikTok Drafts (inbox) — they add the caption, switch on the AI-generated label and post in the app; pass userConsent: true only after the user agreed. Idempotent per (videoId, platform): a repeat returns the first result and never posts twice (a video already posted from the website counts). Respects platform caps (YouTube ≈5 uploads/day; TikTok's pending-drafts limit). Not connected → NOT_CONNECTED with a connectUrl. Requires the "video:create" scope. Free.

addAttribution.description: YouTube only. Append "Made with StoryShort", a link and #StoryShort to the description. Default false: set true ONLY if the user explicitly asked for it.

description.description: YouTube description. #Shorts is added if missing.

madeForKids.description: YouTube COPPA declaration. Omit to use the series answer, or the niche default.

title.description: YouTube title (cleaned and cut to 60 characters on a word). Defaults to the video title.

userConsent.description: TikTok only: the user agreed to send this video to their TikTok drafts.
